subject.title: feat(secrets): expose degraded owners to operators

question: Should `status` permanently expose the additive typed `secrets.degraded[]` contract while retaining `degradedSecretOwners` for compatibility?
rationale: This adds a public gateway protocol shape and a duplicated compatibility projection; code correctness alone cannot choose the permanent operator API.

options.title: Approve nested contract
options.body: Adopt `secrets.degraded[]` as the canonical typed surface and retain the legacy cold-owner field as a documented compatibility projection.

options.title: Extend legacy field only
options.body: Represent stale state in the existing flat field and avoid adding a second public status structure.

options.title: Defer protocol exposure
options.body: Keep the runtime inventory internal until maintainers settle the permanent status schema and client migration plan.

recommendation.title: Approve nested contract
recommendation.body: Adopt `secrets.degraded[]` as the canonical typed surface and retain the legacy cold-owner field as a documented compatibility projection.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository lead is the current assignee and the PR explicitly requests a maintainer decision on this additive protocol contract.
